<div class="single-holder">
	<div class="article">
		<h1 class="headline">Homestead Tariffs 2026</h1>
		<p style="text-align:center">Tariffs are advised in Australian Dollars, including all compulsory Government or regulatory charges (e.g. GST).</p>
<p style="text-align:center">Below mentioned tariffs, as well as additional tariffs may apply, are to be read in conjunction with:<br /><a href="http://gnaraloostation.com/homestead-terms-and-conditions/" style="color:orange"> Booking Terms and Conditions</a> and <a href="https://gnaraloostation.com/know-before-you-go/" style="color:orange">Know before you go</a>.</p>
<hr class="wp-block-coblocks-dynamic-separator is-style-fullwidth" style="height:20px"/>
<p class="has-text-align-center has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Homestead &#8211; Off Peak Period Rates</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center has-large-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Homestead &#8211; Peak Period Rates</p>
<p class="has-text-align-center has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Annual dates from the 1<sup>st</sup> of May through to 31<sup>st</sup> May inclusive, AND Annual dates aligned to the West Australian Government schools, school holiday dates of what is commonly known as: March/April school holidays, June/July school holidays, September/October school holidays</p>
